q: The voltage of ________ goes alternately negative and positive, making the current flow backwards and forwards through the circuit. 2025
e: The voltage of the live wire alternates between positive and negative potentials, producing alternating current.

q: In what year did Joseph Henry and Michel Faraday make their independent discoveries related to electric current and magnetic fields? 2024
e: Electromagnetic induction was independently discovered by Michael Faraday and Joseph Henry in 1831.

q: Why is AC preferred over DC for long-distance power distribution of electrical power? 2024
e: AC voltage can be stepped up to reduce current during transmission, minimizing power loss as heat.

q: What is the SI unit of magnetic flux density? 2024
e: The SI unit of magnetic flux density is tesla (T).

q: ________ current is good in long distance distribution of electrical power. 2025
e: Alternating current (AC) is preferred for long-distance power transmission due to low energy losses.

q: Most generators give out ________. 2024
e: Most practical power generators output alternating current (AC).

q: In an electric generator, ________ energy is converted into electrical energy. 2024
e: Generators convert mechanical rotational energy into electrical energy.

q: There is no ideal transformer with ________ efficiency. 2024
e: Energy losses in real transformers prevent them from achieving 100% efficiency.

q: The SI unit of magnetic flux is the ________. 2024
e: The SI unit of magnetic flux is the weber (Wb).

q: ________ is kept at zero voltage by the electricity supply company. 2025
e: The neutral wire is maintained at zero electrical potential relative to the earth.

q: In US, the electricity standards are ________. 2025
e: The standard domestic electrical supply in the United States is 120 V at 60 Hz.

q: Which of the following gives the polarity of the induced emf? 2025
e: Lenz's law determines the direction and polarity of an induced electromotive force.

q: In ________ the electrons flow steadily in the same direction all the time. 2025
e: Direct current (DC) involves electron movement in a single continuous direction.

q: Because of power losses, there is no ideal transformer with ________ efficiency. 2025
e: Due to copper and core losses, no real transformer reaches 100% efficiency.

q: According to Lenz's Law, the induced current in a closed circuit: 2025
a: Supports the change in magnetic flux
Opposes the change in magnetic flux
Is independent of the change in magnetic flux
e: Lenz's law states that induced current always opposes the change in flux causing it.

q: What is the primary function of a neutral wire in an electrical system? 2025
a: To provide safety by grounding the circuit
To carry excess current during overloads
To complete the circuit by returning current to the source
e: The neutral wire provides the return path for electrical current to complete the circuit.

q: ________ is a scalar quantity. 2025
e: Magnetic flux is a scalar quantity obtained from the dot product of magnetic field and area.

q: The primary danger of electricity to humans is: 2025
e: Electric current passing through human tissues causes electric shock and damage.

q: The magnetic flux is ________ when the magnetic field is parallel to the surface area. 2025
e: When the field lines are parallel to the surface area, no lines penetrate it, giving zero flux.

q: Which of the following is reduced by using laminated iron core in a transformer? 2025
e: Laminating the core restricts circulating paths, thereby reducing eddy current power loss.

q: Which of the following is not used to protect us from the possibility of receiving an electric shock? 2025
e: The live wire delivers power and is not a safety protective device.

q: There is no ideal transformer with ________ efficiency. 2025
e: Real transformers suffer from internal losses, preventing them from attaining 100% efficiency.

q: In any electric appliance the ________ wire is always connected to the metal case. 2025
e: The earth wire is grounded to the metal outer case to prevent electric shocks.

q: In an electric generator, ________ is converted into electrical energy. 2025
e: Electric generators convert mechanical energy into electrical energy.

q: The SI unit of magnetic flux density is tesla (T) which is equivalent to ________. 2025
e: One tesla equals one weber per square metre (Wb/m²).

q: The core of a transformer is built up of ________ iron sheets of high resistance. 2025
e: Thin laminated iron sheets are used to construct transformer cores to limit eddy currents.

q: Which of the following is the SI unit of magnetic flux density? 2025
e: Magnetic flux density is measured in tesla (T).

q: In any electrical appliance the ________ wire is always connected to the metal case. 2025
e: The earth wire connects the appliance's metal case to ground safety.

q: When the field is perpendicular to the surface area, the magnetic flux is ________. 2025
e: Perpendicular magnetic field lines maximize the flux passing through a surface.

q: In transformer, the voltage in the secondary and the voltage in the primary have ________. 2025
e: Transformers change voltage amplitude while maintaining identical input and output frequencies.

q: Most of the transformers have full load efficiency from 95% to ________. 2025
e: Typical full-load efficiency for modern transformers ranges between 95% and 98.5%.

q: The SI unit of magnetic field strength is the ________. 2026
e: Magnetic field strength (H) has the SI unit of ampere per metre (A/m).

q: A generator converts ________ energy into electrical energy. 2026
e: Generators convert mechanical motion into usable electrical energy.

q: The current from the output of a telephone charger is ________. 2026
e: Phone chargers rectify incoming AC into steady DC output.

q: The phenomenon in which a current flows through a wire loop due to a change in the magnetic lines of force through the loop is called: 2026
e: Electromagnetic induction is the process of generating electric current with changing magnetic flux.

q: Which wire carries the current from the supply to the appliance? 2026
e: The live wire delivers current from the electrical power supply directly to the appliance.
